t: The Mira Event XS power shower in white provides a powerful and invigorating showering experience, engineered for use in low pressure water systems. This rear-fed unit offers precise control over water flow and temperature with its rotary start, flow, and manual temperature controls, making it an excellent bathroom solution for new installations and renovation projects. The included 90mm round shower head features four spray patterns and rub-clean rubber nozzles, simplifying limescale removal and ensuring consistent performance in daily use. This complete kit is supplied with the shower unit, hose, shower head, and riser rail.
b: Suitable for Low Pressure Water Systems Only
